Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the Non-bailable warrant dated 08.05.2024 in Complaint Case No. 1758 of 2017 (Arti Vs. Vipin Kumar Rastogi and others), under Sections 498A I.P.C. & 3/4 D. P. Act, PS Sheeshgarh, District Bareilly, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate Bahedi, Bareilly.

Under the aforesaid circumstances, the application is disposed of with the observation that in case applicants surrender/appear within a period of one month before the Court concerned, they shall not be arrested in pursuance of the Non-bailable warrant dated 08.05.2024 issued against them.
